descriptions.rgb: The camera wearer begins directly in front of an open refrigerator, with the door and shelves about 0.2–0.8 m away; containers and food items fill the shelves, and part of the wearer’s torso is visible at the far left edge. The viewpoint then turns right and retreats from the refrigerator, revealing a kitchen with counters and upper cabinets along the back and right walls, a stove roughly 2–3 m ahead, and a dishwasher with its lower rack extended about 1–2 m ahead-left. In the final two frames, another person stands approximately 3–4 m away near the back-right counter, to the right of the stove, facing mostly toward the counter and not clearly looking at the camera wearer. Countertop objects, dishes, and containers are within that person’s arm’s reach, while the refrigerator and nearby door remain closest to the camera wearer before moving partly or fully out of view on the left during the rightward turn.
